import html # Base HTML template with a placeholder for user-provided content. html_template = """ Visitor Page

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def create_html_response(visitor_content: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML response by inserting the escaped visitor content into a predefined template. Parameters: visitor_content (str): The user-supplied string to embed in the page. Returns: str: A complete HTML document with the visitor content safely escaped. """ # Escape any special characters to prevent XSS or script injection. safe_content = html.escape(visitor_content, quote=True) # Render the template with the escaped content. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
